label: 6b-c
tail:
Step-6b adjudication for group c (batches 1, 6, 8) is complete. Both artifacts are written.

## What this dispatch was

My prior `6b-c` run **timed out** at 4 h on the retired `gpt-5.6-sol` lane after finishing the reader adjudication but before any refuter returned. I verified that inherited work rather than re-deriving it, then did the remainder.

## The refuter round found seven fatal defects on already-read text

Four read-only refuters (one per A/B pair, `claude-opus-5[1m]`, sandbox-enforced). Worth stating plainly: for these batches my brief's same-family warning **doesn't apply** — batches 1/6/8 were authored and first read on GPT lanes before the 2026-08-23 swap, so this was a genuine cross-family read.

**Fatal, all repaired:**
- **`ex-generator-rank-of-upper-unitriangular-groups`** — the title named $U_3(\mathbb F_q)$ over any prime power, where the claim is **false**: $d(U_3(\mathbb F_4))=4$, not 2. The body proved it only over the prime field and never connected its coordinate group to a matrix. Title narrowed, matrix identification supplied and verified, boundary recorded in a Remark.
- **Three Carathéodory items** silently spending the Axiom of Countable Choice while seven siblings on the same page declare it. The sharpest — `prop-caratheodory-extension-compares-with-other-extensions` — presupposes its extension is a measure, which *is* the countable-choice theorem, listed in `deps` and restated in no Fact. I overrode the refuter's "nonfatal" here: the page's own bookkeeping convention makes an undeclared use an unproved ZF claim.
- **`thm-hadamard-three-lines`** — the endpoint clause evaluates to $0^0$, which the definition it cites leaves *undefined*, in a reachable case.
- **`lem-local-holomorphic-logarithm-nonvanishing-function-on-disc`** — credited a remark with "discs are star-shaped", which that remark does not say, on the hypothesis driving the whole complex-analysis chain.
- **`thm-primitive-sum-of-two-squares-characterisation`** — a `[L5]` restatement giving a different clause than the step uses.

Plus 14 nonfatal, all repaired at step 6 where it costs an edit rather than a rejudge.

## Also delivered
- **87 risk reviews** — all missing ones in the run were mine; `risk-report --require-reviewed` is now green run-wide.
- **Harvest re-verified by extracting source PDFs**, not HTTP status: Tropp §7.2–7.3 and Hackman Ch. E. Hackman E.II.8(b) says "every integer $P>1$ dividing $N$" — independently confirming the earlier R1-3 title repair.
- All six `ai-generated` constructions verified as *statements* by direct enumeration; none is a dependency target.

## Three things I did not close, deliberately

1. **`gate-liveness` is red** — `finite-smoke` declares **zero** obligations across all nine batches. I did not attach a token check: none of the registry's ten tests a headline assertion in my batches, and a token one would make a run-wide vacuity look discharged. Batches 3 and 9 are where the algebraic checks plausibly fit.
2. **`depcheck` red** on a published *frontier-16* item missing `verification.sources_checked` — not my level, not a falsehood, outside the repair delegation. Its source URL is live; evidence recorded.
3. **A shared boundary rationale** — the merged template cluster is green **only because it dropped below three members** when I turned my row into a determination. The two batch-7 rows still carry the identical sentence.
